mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_call_log (purpose, ref_id, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, success_yn, error_message) VALUES (#{purpose}, #{refId}, #{model}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{successYn}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_call_log WHERE purpose = #{purpose} AND ref_id = #{refId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(latency_ms), 0) AS latency_ms, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN success_yn = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_count FROM ai_call_log WHERE (purpose IN ('EVIDENCE', 'EDUCATION_EVAL', 'TIMELINE', 'CAREER_EVAL', 'QUESTION', 'ARRANGE') AND ref_id = #{candidateId}) OR (purpose = 'CRITERIA_EXTRACT' AND ref_id = #{positionId})
